general_response_process: Confirm the signal using CloudWatch metrics and logs.
Determine whether the issue is service, input, drift, or model related.
Correlate using request IDs where applicable.
Mitigate without bypassing validation or governance controls.
Escalate for human review when required.

server_error_rate.trigger: Server error rate > 5% during a 5-minute period.
investigate: Check recent deployments or configuration changes.
Verify model artifacts can be loaded.
mitigation: Rollback a faulty deployment if identified.
Keep monitoring failures isolated from inference.
do_not: Disable API validation to reduce errors.
Expose raw customer payloads during debugging.
Silently change the model decision threshold.

high_latency.trigger: p95 API latency > 1000 ms during a 5-minute period.
investigate: Inspect latency trend and request volume.

validation_failure_rate.trigger: Validation failure rate > 10% during a 15-minute period.
investigate: Inspect validation error types without logging raw payloads.
Check whether clients are using unsupported values.
mitigation: Coordinate intentional schema changes through versioning.
Update the API contract only through controlled release.
do_not: Relax validation solely to suppress the alarm.
Accept unknown categories without model-impact review.

significant_feature_drift.trigger: At least one monitored feature reaches SIGNIFICANT_DRIFT.
investigate: Review PSI, binary-rate shift, or TVD.
Compare current population with training reference.
Check upstream data-generation or schema changes.
Check whether the shift is expected business seasonality.
mitigation: Continue monitoring if drift is legitimate and low risk.
Correct upstream data defects when confirmed.
Perform model evaluation using labeled outcomes.
Consider retraining only after evidence-based review.
do_not: Automatically retrain solely because PSI/TVD crossed a threshold.

unseen_category.trigger: One or more categorical values are absent from the training reference vocabulary.
investigate: Identify the affected feature and category.
Determine whether it is a data-quality error.
Determine whether it represents a legitimate new business value.
Assess whether training data must be expanded.
mitigation: Evaluate legitimate new categories before model updates.
do_not: Silently map an unknown category to an arbitrary known value.
Automatically retrain without validation and approval.

model_performance_degradation.reason: True model performance requires observed outcome labels. Current online monitoring primarily observes service health, input quality, prediction behaviour, and population drift.
when_labels_arrive: Join predictions to observed outcomes using governed identifiers.
Calculate precision, recall, F1 and confusion matrix at threshold 0.20.
Compare against approved baseline and previous periods.
Perform human review before retraining or model replacement.
